text:
Ethan: Quick heads up from the Python onboarding run: sampleapp-python sometimes logs full auth tokens in debug traces when OTel is enabled + our redactor isn't kicking in. Also noticed log level flips to DEBUG even when REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO is set via env.

Ethan: Repro steps I used:
1) git clone https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp-python-telemetry
2) python -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
3) REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO python app.py (with otel auto instrument env vars set)
4) hit /v1/generate a few times with retries enabled

Priya: Do you have a paste of the offending log line (sanitized ok)?

Ethan: Yep pasted minimal snippet:
INFO [req=6f2] request start
DEBUG [req=6f2] http.client response headers: {"authorization": "Bearer sk-live-xxx"}
INFO [req=6f2] handler done

Lin: That looks like our redactor didn't parse the http.client instrumentation payload. The python otel plugins sometimes emit headers as bytes or nested dicts, and our serializer only handles str. If token appears as bytes we won't pattern-match and redact.

Marta: Also the log level flip is worrying. Is the otel bootstrap setting logging.basicConfig somewhere? Some instrumentations call logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG) which can override.

Ethan: I grepped: opentelemetry-instrumentation-http-client calls logging.getLogger('opentelemetry').setLevel(DEBUG) in dev builds. In our environment otel env VAR OTEL_PYTHON_TRACES_EXPORTER=jaeger and OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=debug were present in the CI image, but onboarding docs didn't mention that. New users get a debug-heavy output.

Priya: Two issues then: 1) redaction parity between Python and Node SDKs, 2) env var precedence and unexpected OTEL_LOG_LEVEL leaking into runtime.

Lin: Quick mitigation: update python redactor to coerce bytes to str and deep-scan nested mappings for header-like keys. Also treat any key matching /auth|authorization|token|api[-_]?key/i as PII candidate. I can patch that.

Ethan: I created a repro branch and a tiny test that simulates otel emitting bytes header: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp-python-telemetry/branch/redact-bytes-repro. Test reproduces nondeterministically ~20% of runs.

Marta: Telemetry-bot, please open DX-7438 and link PR once ready. Also add a note to onboarding checklist about OTEL_* envs in local dev images.

telemetry-bot: Created ticket DX-7438: "python redactor: handle bytes and nested header structures; document OTEL env leakage". Assigned to Lin. Priority P2.

Priya: For the log level problem, we should decide precedence: explicit REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL env must win over OTEL_LOG_LEVEL and any library-level setLevel calls. We can implement: on logger init, call logging.setLevel() with env value and call logging.root.manager.disable = 0 and then reconfigure child loggers accordingly.

Lin: Agreed. I'll make the redactor change and add a logger.init(force_env=True) flag that enforces env precedence and reconfigures after instrumentations run. Also will add a small e2e that runs otel instrumentation then initializes logger to confirm enforcement.

Ethan: One more parity note: Node's logger already has a redact transformer for Buffer objects and nested headers. Let's make python match behavior: redact tokens replaced with <redacted> and only keep last 6 chars for tracing (e.g., sk-xxxxxx123456 -> <redacted:...123456>). Good for debugging while limiting exposure.

Marta: Love that approach. Make sure we surface the exact behavior in the onboarding guide and sampleapp README. Include snippet for serverless (lambda) where cold starts + instrumentation ordering causes different startup sequences.

Priya: Also add a CLI check in the sampleapp bootstrap that warns if OTEL_LOG_LEVEL is set to debug in local dev images: print a one-line notice recommending to unset or set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL to INFO. That will save a lot of support noise.

Ethan: I'll add the CLI warning and update the python sampleapp README with repro + mitigation. Lin, ping me when your branch is ready and I'll validate.

telemetry-bot: DX-7438 updated: assignee Lin; status in-progress; linked branch redact-bytes-repro.

Lin: Starting patch now. Will include unit tests for bytes handling and nested header maps plus an integration test that ensures REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL overrides OTEL_LOG_LEVEL.

Marta: Great. Thanks team. Keep the fixes small and ship a point release for the sampleapps and SDKs so onboarding customers get the safe defaults quickly.

Ethan: Thanks everyone, will follow up when CLI PR lands.
